fusions.name: Forked Feint
fusions.desc: Feints two ways at once at up to 3 enemies within 4 tiles, which deals 26 damage to each, ignoring their resistances. They turn against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Split Jab
fusions.desc: Flicks a jab at the first enemy in line up to 7 tiles away, dealing 4 damage. It then splits to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Took the Other Path
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 8 seconds. While it lasts, a second you peels off the other way and fights beside you, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Roll
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
